refund.v: Full refund of the INITIAL PAYMENT if the membership is cancelled within 30 calendar days of the enrollment date. Cancellation must be by written notice to members@firstenroll.com. Refunds issued to the original payment method within 7-10 business days of confirmation.

states.v: STATES panel: AL, AR, AZ, GA, IL, KY, MS, NC, ND, NE, NV, OH, OK, OR, TX, UT, VA (17 states). The INFORMATION panel prose on the same page reads 'Product State Availability - AL, AR, AZ, GA, IL, KY, MS, NE, NV, NC, ND, OH, OK, OR, TX, UT, VA.' - the two lists AGREE.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Describing any of these as insurance. Describing a discount program as insurance is a material misrepresentation. Six are named as discount programs; the rest are simply unknown, including products whose names sound insured such as AD&D, Critical Care, Term Life and Fusion Dental.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not describe AssistPro, GapSupport, Ameriguard, Prime Health Pass, Express Health Tools or HealthAssist as insurance or as coverage - the portal names each of them a Discount. Do not describe the remaining 36 at all until typed. Do not say 'PPO' about Allstate Dental PPO in a way implying major medical.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Nothing product-specific. An add-on should not be described until its type is established.

source.sec: NEO product list; registry entries with product_type NEEDS_MANUAL_VERIFICATION

compliance_risks.verified_fact: 43 add-on products are listed on the NEO platform. NONE has a document in Drive. 36 of them could not be assigned a product type from any available source. Six are typed as discount programs solely because the portal's own product name contains the word 'Discount'.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Before mentioning any add-on by name on a recorded call.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Classifying any product from its name. Doing so produces errors in both directions - calling insurance a membership, and calling a service a discount.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Never type or describe a product from its name. Read the Info page.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Nothing client-facing. This is an internal rule.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Product names in this portfolio are unreliable indicators of product type IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. 'AWA SimpleShield Membership Plan' is fixed indemnity insurance. 'Prime Health Pass Discount' is described on its own page as a Diagnostic Services Product delivering services. Between April and September NEO inserted the word 'Membership' into four Safe Guard product names without any evident change of type. Meanwhile 'AssistPro Discount' genuinely is a discount program.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Before any add-on is described on a call, and before any tooling assigns it a category.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Naming conditions. A client asks 'does it cover a heart attack?' or 'does it cover cancer?' and there is no source that says yes or no. Critical illness products commonly carry a waiting period, a pre-existing exclusion, a first-diagnosis requirement, and severity or staging definitions that exclude early-stage cancer - none of which can be confirmed or denied here.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not name a single covered condition. Do not quote the dollar figure from the product name as the benefit. Do not say there is no waiting period or no pre-existing exclusion - the source is silent, which is not the same as absent.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: This pays a lump sum if you are diagnosed with a covered critical illness. I do not have the list of which illnesses are covered in front of me, and I am not going to guess at it - let me get you the disclosures first.

source.sec: TERMS panel; Info panels confirmed empty on 38175 and 38178

compliance_risks.verified_fact: The only benefit statement available is a scope limitation from the enrollment agreement: the plan 'only pays benefits for loss resulting in a covered critical illness'. The list of covered critical illnesses is NOT_FOUND_IN_SOURCE. The benefit amount is NOT_FOUND_IN_SOURCE. No waiting period, pre-existing provision or exclusion is stated anywhere.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Obtain the 'Insurance Disclosures' and 'General Membership Disclosures' the client is required to attest to. See G-040.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Telling a client to call the carrier or the administrator with a claims question. Under the agreement the client has been directed to the agent. Also: not mentioning that the product can be swapped by default.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not tell the client FirstEnroll will answer their coverage questions.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: For anything about benefits, coverage or a claim, I am your contact - the agreement names me, not the billing company. And if this plan is ever discontinued they can move you to a similar product; you would get written notice and can opt out.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The signed enrollment agreement states that FirstEnroll does not underwrite or decide claims, and that ALL inquiries about benefits, coverage and claims must be directed to the WRITING AGENT. It also contains a rollover clause allowing FirstEnroll to move the enrollment to a 'substantially similar product' if the plan becomes unavailable, subject to written notice and opt-out.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Whether the agency has a process for handling inbound claims questions it has contractually accepted.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Nothing directly - this is a defect in the document, not in what the agent says. But it means the clause telling the client who to contact about claims may be unreadable, and the client may later say they were never told who their agent was.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not tell a client the agreement names their agent.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Give the client your own name, agency and email verbally on the recorded call, and confirm you are their contact for benefit and claims questions. Do not rely on the agreement to have done it.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The FirstEnroll enrollment-agreement template served on the live storefront contains unrendered variables - $parentcompany, $product_label, $agent_fullname, $agent_Email, $parentemail - confirmed on two unrelated product families (American Financial Critical Illness page 38175, and Health Choice Silver page 32339). The affected clauses are the third-party administrator disclaimer, the Plan and Claims Inquiries clause and the Writing Agent Contact block.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Raise with FirstEnroll whether the executed enrollment document renders these variables. See G-039.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: For any product in this group, do not answer a coverage, exclusion, waiting-period or pre-existing question on a recorded call from portal material alone. Obtain the carrier document first.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: 51 of the 80 products on the NEO agent storefront have no brochure, certificate or policy document attached anywhere in the enrolment system. For those products the NEO reference page is the only available source, and four of those pages carry a limitations or exclusions heading with no text beneath it.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Until the PDFs are filed, any compliance challenge to a benefit statement on these products can be answered only with the ledger's citations, not with the underlying document. Treat filing them as outstanding remediation, not housekeeping.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Ten of the eleven linked brochures are READ and fully extracted into the ledger, but the PDF files themselves are not in Drive. The documents behind 25 live variants therefore exist in this project only as extracted facts, not as retrievable source documents.

The enrollee certifies they will not dispute scheduled payments with their card company or bank. FirstEnroll: 101 Crawfords Corner Road Suite 4233, Holmdel, NJ 07733.

terms.plan_rollover.v: If the selected Plan becomes unavailable, FirstEnroll may transition the enrollment to a 'substantially similar product at no additional cost', with advance written notice and an opportunity to opt out. The writing agent remains the same.

terms.tcpa_consent.v: By signing, the enrollee expressly consents to recurring telephone calls, SMS/MMS and emails from FirstEnroll, including via automatic telephone dialing system or artificial/prerecorded voice. Opt out by replying STOP.
